zero_budget_policy.native_gpu: optional; local or genuinely zero-cost only
zero_budget_policy.browser_pwa: primary playable delivery path until a truly free native GPU host exists
zero_budget_policy.stripe: reserved for the existing BridgePoint account but DO_NOT_CONNECT until owner explicitly gives final go-ahead

required_geometry: functional room doors with collision and animation
true wall openings for windows and doorways
see-through/open windows that expose outside world
prohibited: fake card/teleport door system as the primary interior traversal method

infected_progression.mid_event: mixed runners, armored and regional variants
infected_progression.late_event: higher density, faster/specialized threats and stronger horde coordination

regional_identity.goal: each state/jurisdiction should feel geographically recognizable but zombified/horrorified
regional_identity.ip_rule: original presentation only; other franchises are feel references, never copied content

endgame.origin: outer playable perimeter of the U.S. and jurisdictions
endgame.pressure_goal: push remaining survivors toward larger cities
endgame.finale: major-city showdown of surviving players near event end

store.pricing_rule: reasonable microtransaction bands; never required for competitive viability

operational_rules: make measurable code/data/test progress each run
never spend money or provision billable services
never start Year One without explicit owner instruction
never connect Stripe until explicit final owner instruction
publish only after relevant validation gates pass
